_doc: What the MolmoAct2 LoRA fine-tune on molmoact2-cal2-456-3stage-20261114 was trained on. run_finetuned.sh and smolvla_control.py --training-tasks use it: every prompt sent to the model must be one of `tasks`. Read from the dataset on Joe's Spark (meta/tasks.parquet, MANIFEST.json) on 2026-11-14.
tasks: bring the brick to the inspection camera
place the brick in the orange bowl
place the brick in the purple bowl
place the brick in the yellow bowl

stages.bring: bring the brick to the inspection camera
stages.place: place the brick in the {colour} bowl

stage_boundaries: pick < grasp_frame (gripper closes on the brick) <= bring < inspection_frame (operator mark) <= place
calibration_note: the current (post 2026-11-14 01:00) follower calibration: ~/inference/dlsj-smolvla and ~/desmond/build/dlsj-main on the XPS; no --joint-offset
ready_pose_note: median first-frame state of the 409 training episodes (IQR 24/47/43/32/20/20 deg): demos start from varied poses above the table, gripper open
control: absolute joint pose, LeRobot degrees, gripper 0-100, 30 Hz
